about: What GitHub’s machine printed for p-4 and p-5 on each gate run recorded here, copied word for word from the run’s log (node tools/ci-tarpit.mjs <runId>). CI prints these two without requiring them to match receipts/tarpit.json, because they turn on how fast the attacker’s machine pays the proof-of-work. The committed receipt keeps the laptop’s verdicts.
